breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet and Periodic types. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly omitted the contradictory periodic boundary condition and only included the Dirichlet conditions, thus resolving the inconsistency in alignment with the ground truth.
